output:
Nephi identifies himself as the one who “make[s] a record of [his] proceedings,” having been “highly favored of the Lord” and given “a great knowledge of the goodness and the mysteries of God.” He is described as one who sought the Lord “diligently,” and later is remembered as “a great protector” who “labored in all his days for [the people’s] welfare.”

#### Sources

- [1 Nephi 1:1] — “*I, Nephi, having been born of goodly parents… having been highly favored of the Lord in all my days; yea, having had a great knowledge of the goodness and the mysteries of God, therefore I make a record of my proceedings in my days.*”
- [1 Nephi 2:19] — “*Blessed art thou, Nephi, because of thy faith, for thou hast sought me diligently, with lowliness of heart.*”
- [Jacob 1:10] — “*The people having loved Nephi exceedingly, he having been a great protector for them, having wielded the sword of Laban in their defence, and having labored in all his days for their welfare—*”
- [2 Nephi 1:1] — “*…after I, Nephi, had made an end of teaching my brethren, our father, Lehi, also spake many things unto them… how great things the Lord had done for them in bringing them out of the land of Jerusalem.*”
